ns2:section.sectionText: Are you someone who likes to connect different fields (e.g., art, science, design, or history)? Based on the premise that broad interdisciplinary knowledge promotes creativity, this course allows you to explore wide ranging topics and then connect your new learning to engineering and the solving of global problems. You will study a few preliminary topics to help establish a renaissance mindset, and then you will study one topic of your own choosing in depth. You will create a plan to continue your development as a renaissance engineer.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
